# One-Bowl Soft Chocolate Chip Cookies

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg

A chewy, soft cookie recipe built for one bowl and no mixer. It uses your exact ingredients and keeps the method simple.

# Chewy Cookie Method

## Ingredients
- 120 g butter, melted and slightly cooled
- 100 g brown sugar
- 50 g white sugar
- 1 egg
- 180 g all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 150 g chocolate chips

## Instructions
1. Heat the oven to **175°C**. Line a baking tray with parchment paper.
2. In one bowl, mix the **melted butter**, **brown sugar**, and **white sugar** until glossy and smooth.
3. Add the **egg** and stir until fully combined.
4. Add the **flour**, **baking soda**, and **salt**. Mix just until no dry streaks remain.
5. Fold in the **chocolate chips**.
6. Scoop dough into **12 equal portions** and place them well spaced on the tray.
7. Bake for **9–11 minutes**, until the edges look set but the centers still look soft.
8. Let cookies cool on the tray for **10 minutes** before moving them to a rack.

## Yield and Bake Details
- **Yield:** about **12 cookies**
- **Oven temperature:** **175°C**
- **Bake time:** **9–11 minutes**
- **Texture goal:** lightly golden edges, soft centers

## Tips for Extra Chewy Cookies
- Do not overmix after adding the flour.
- Pull them from the oven when the centers still look a little underdone.
- Use **melted butter** for a denser, chewier texture.
- Chill the dough for **20–30 minutes** if you want thicker cookies.
- Slightly underbake rather than overbake; they finish setting as they cool.
